title: SA Classical Event
description: One performance at one venue at one date and time. A three-night run is three records.

id.description: Stable slug: sha256(dedupe_key) truncated to 16 hex chars. Never regenerate for an existing event.

dedupe_key.description: Lowercase, punctuation-stripped: {date_YYYY-MM-DD}|{venue_slug}|{normalised_title_first_6_words}. Used for cross-source matching before fuzzy fallback.

description.description: Max 400 chars. Summary in own words, NOT copied blurb text. Copyright: never reproduce the publisher's marketing copy verbatim.

start.description: ISO 8601 with explicit +02:00 offset. South Africa has no DST, so the offset is always +02:00.

venue_id.description: Slug from the canonical venue table, e.g. 'linder-auditorium'.

presenter.description: The organisation putting it on, canonicalised. E.g. 'Johannesburg Philharmonic Orchestra', not 'the JPO'.

series.description: E.g. 'CPO Symphony Season 2026', 'Johannesburg International Mozart Festival 2026'.

instrument.description: For soloists and accompanists. Includes voice types: soprano, mezzo-soprano, contralto, countertenor, tenor, baritone, bass.

is_south_african.description: Only true when the source states it or it is unambiguous from a known-artist table. Otherwise null. Do not guess from surname.

programme.description: Works to be performed, in stated order. Empty array is valid and common.

composer.description: Canonical full name where confidently known: 'Ludwig van Beethoven', not 'Beethoven'. If ambiguous (e.g. bare 'Bach', 'Strauss'), keep the source form and add to needs_review.

sa_content.description: The local-is-lekker index. Drives the 'South African works' filter, which is the site's differentiator.

sa_composers.description: Composers on the programme matched against the SA composer table. Match only, never infer.

languages.description: For vocal programmes: Afrikaans, isiXhosa, isiZulu, Sesotho, English, German, Italian, Latin, French, Russian, Czech.

url.description: Canonical page for this event. Always link out; never republish full copy.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the raw source document. Skip the LLM call when unchanged.

confidence.description: Extractor's own confidence. Below 0.75 routes to the review queue rather than publishing.

needs_review.description: Dotted field paths the extractor is unsure about, e.g. ['start', 'programme.1.composer'].

extraction_notes.description: One line, for the human reviewer only. Never rendered on the site.
